name: n8n workflow-TalentSphere AI — End-to-End v6 Fixed Conditional Routing

nodes.name: 1. Streamlit Intake / Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: TA/Recruiter uploads CSV through Streamlit and starts analysis. Hiring Manager may optionally request analysis.

nodes.name: 2. Hiring Data Sources
nodes.notes: Receives CSV/Mock ATS/Interview and Offer records converted to JSON by Streamlit.

nodes.name: 3. Ingest, Validate & Clean
nodes.notes: Schema checks, normalization, duplicate handling, invalid-row quarantine, and role filtering.

nodes.name: 4. Routing Agent
nodes.notes: Selects applicable agents based on requested analysis and required fields.

nodes.name: 5A. Sourcing Quality Agent
nodes.notes: Explicit architecture agent. Sends a grounded analysis request to Shared RAG.

nodes.name: 5B. Rejection Pattern Agent
nodes.notes: Explicit architecture agent. Sends a grounded analysis request to Shared RAG.

nodes.name: 5C. Offer Insights Agent
nodes.notes: Explicit architecture agent. Sends a grounded analysis request to Shared RAG.

nodes.name: 5D. Pipeline Health Agent
nodes.notes: Explicit architecture agent. Sends a grounded analysis request to Shared RAG.

nodes.name: 5E. Panel Load Balancer — Direct Execution
nodes.notes: Fifth agent. Executes deterministic workload logic, bypasses Shared RAG and Shared LLM, then passes through the common Standardized Agent JSON Output node.

nodes.name: 5F. Merge Four Grounded Agent Requests
nodes.notes: Technical orchestration node: combines the four explicit grounded-agent requests into one Shared RAG service.

nodes.name: 7A. Build Grounded Reasoning Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the grounded GPT-4o-mini request using uploaded hiring records and Pinecone-retrieved policy context.

nodes.name: 8. Standardized Agent JSON Output
nodes.notes: Common formatter for all five agents. Both grounded LLM outputs and the deterministic Panel Load Balancer output must pass through this node before aggregation.

nodes.name: 7D. Merge Four Grounded + One Direct Agent
nodes.notes: Combines four Shared-LLM agent responses with the direct Panel Load Balancer response before the common standardization step.

nodes.name: 9. Aggregate Agent
nodes.notes: Combines completed outputs without redoing agent reasoning. Supports partial results.

nodes.name: 10. JSON Validation
nodes.notes: Validates every agent result against the shared output contract.

nodes.name: 10A. JSON Repair — One Attempt
nodes.notes: Adds safe defaults for missing contract fields and forces human review.

nodes.name: 11A. Build Evaluation Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds a GPT-4o-mini evaluation request. It receives either the original validated output or the repaired-and-revalidated output directly, without waiting on a mutually exclusive Merge branch.

nodes.name: 12A. Human Review Queue
nodes.notes: Authorized reviewer approves, approves with conditions, rejects, or requests revision.

parameters.jsCode:
const canPublish=$json.quality_gate?.quality_threshold_met===true&&$json.aggregate?.partial_success===false&&$json.json_validation?.valid===true&&$json.quality_gate?.requires_human_review===false;
return [{json:{...$json,human_review:{required:false,status:"NOT_REQUIRED",decision:canPublish?"AUTO_PUBLISH":"BLOCKED"},publication_status:canPublish?"APPROVED_FOR_DASHBOARD":"NOT_PUBLISHED",observability:[...($json.observability||[]),{component:"publication",event:canPublish?"AUTO_PUBLISHED":"AUTO_PUBLISH_BLOCKED",status:canPublish?"SUCCESS":"FAILED",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}]}}];

nodes.name: 13. Observability
nodes.notes: Summarizes telemetry appended throughout ingestion, routing, RAG, LLM, agents, validation, evaluation, and review.

nodes.name: 14. Optimization
nodes.notes: Uses observability results to recommend routing, model, caching, and prompt improvements for future runs.

nodes.name: 15. Streamlit Dashboard / Final Review
nodes.notes: Displays insights, evidence, confidence, cost, latency, agent status, and review outcome for Hiring Manager / TA Lead.

nodes.name: 6A. Prepare Pinecone Retrieval Query
nodes.notes: Builds an agent-specific retrieval query and Pinecone metadata filter. Runs once for each grounded agent request.

nodes.name: 6B. Pinecone Knowledge Base Search
nodes.notes: Queries the integrated-embedding Pinecone index in namespace talentsphere-dev. Pinecone embeds query text with llama-text-embed-v2 and returns the top five agent-filtered policy chunks.

nodes.name: 6C. Build Grounded Retrieval Context
nodes.notes: Combines the Pinecone search response with the original agent request, normalizes retrieved chunks to the existing retrieval.documents contract, and blocks ungrounded execution when no documents are returned.

nodes.name: 7C. Parse OpenAI Reasoning JSON
nodes.notes: Parses GPT-4o-mini JSON, restores the original workflow item, and records actual token usage, latency, response ID, and estimated cost.

nodes.name: 11C. Parse OpenAI Evaluation JSON
nodes.notes: Parses and normalizes GPT-4o-mini judge results, fails closed when an expected agent is missing, and records usage, latency, and estimated cost.

nodes.name: 7B. OpenAI GPT-4o-mini Reasoning
nodes.notes: Calls the OpenAI Responses API with GPT-4.1. After import, select your OpenAI credential in this node if n8n does not match it automatically.

nodes.name: 11B. OpenAI GPT-4o-mini Evaluation
nodes.notes: Calls GPT-4.1 as an independent judge. After import, select your OpenAI credential in this node if n8n does not match it automatically.
